channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Trump envoy's financial ties to oil pipeline firm revealed

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Bessent Skips IMF-World Bank Meetings
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will not attend the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank meetings scheduled to take place in Bangkok. The reason for his absence was not specified in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jeff Bezos predicts AI-driven 3-day workweek
item.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos has stated that artificial intelligence could enable a three-day workweek and assist single-income families. He believes AI's advancements will lead to these changes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The 8th Pay Commission's report, which will determine salary and pension increases for government employees, is anticipated in 2027. Details regarding the extent of salary hikes and pension adjustments remain uncertain, with employees… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Lifts Sanctions on Russian Diesel Sales
item.description: The United States has lifted sanctions on the sale of Russian diesel in global markets, a move that will be effective until April 2027. The decision was announced on Friday. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Poonawalla Fincorp announced a net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, a five-fold increase year-on-year. The company's net interest income rose by 75.6% due to loan portfolio expansion. New disbursements accounted for 28% of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: India aims for $1 trillion exports by FY27
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal has expressed confidence that India will achieve its target of $1 trillion in exports by the fiscal year 2027. The strategy to reach this goal reportedly involves leveraging Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Bond yields are experiencing a global increase, affecting both those who borrow money and those who invest. The reasons behind this rise and its specific implications for borrowers and investors are being examined. The situation has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: UN Trade Body Predicts Slowing Global Economic Growth
item.description: The United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) projects that global economic growth will decelerate to 2.6 percent in 2026. This forecast indicates a slowdown in the world economy for the coming years. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury yields ease after strong bond auction demand
item.description: US Treasury yields retreated from recent highs following a strong auction of 30-year bonds, which drew unexpectedly firm demand. The selloff in US bonds also eased, with yields moving off their peaks after the solid auction of 10-year… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Starbucks Reportedly Explored Acquiring Chipotle
item.description: Starbucks has reportedly explored the possibility of acquiring the restaurant chain Chipotle. This exploration was revealed in reports, leading to a jump in Chipotle's stock. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Despite a tourism boom during China's National Day 'golden week' holiday, hotel room rates across mainland China and average spending per domestic trip fell short of expectations. Hotel tariffs remained largely unchanged, and average… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Public Sector Banks Show Strong Business Growth in Q2
item.description: Five public sector banks reported credit growth between 15% and 25% in the second quarter of the financial year 2027. This growth was driven by sustained demand for credit across agriculture, industry, services, and personal loans… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Rise on October 9
item.description: On October 9, the prices of gold and silver saw an increase. The latest rates for gold were reported in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Netflix is reportedly planning to lay off approximately 5% of its workforce, with some reports indicating the cuts could occur as early as next week. The streaming giant is pursuing new revenue streams, including expansion into live… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: The US Federal Reserve is likely to hold interest rates steady in October, with a top official signaling the central bank's intention. This potential pause comes as the US labor market shows signs of cooling more than anticipated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 11 · Right 0.

item.description: France is reportedly facing a potential debt crisis, with concerns escalating due to record debt levels and ongoing high school protests. Economic indicators suggest France's debt is riskier than that of 38% of the nation's company bonds… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 14 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Bond Yields Rise Amid Slowing Selloff
item.description: Global bond yields saw a slight increase as the pace of selling slowed. In related news, global banks are strengthening their teams focused on Japanese debt due to a boom in bond issuance within the country. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EU and China Begin Trade Talks Amidst Currency Claims
item.description: The European Union and China have commenced trade talks, with China's central bank refuting claims of currency manipulation. The EU is reportedly adopting a firmer stance on China's trade practices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Stocks Rebound as Oil Slips, AI Bubble Fears Ease
item.description: US stock markets showed signs of a rebound, influenced by a decrease in oil prices and a receding concern over an "AI bubble." Natural gas futures also settled higher. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Data center projects across Asia are experiencing delays in their Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) and facing government-imposed halts. Investors are reportedly wary of dedicated power projects for these data centers, contributing to the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The United States has suspended the processing of the Permanent Labor Certification (PERM) program for certain Indian IT companies, raising concerns about talent retention for employees seeking permanent residency. Industry analysts… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: JSW to Launch First Combat SUV on December 4
item.description: JSW is set to launch its first combat SUV on December 4. The vehicle is reported to have a range of 1100 km on a full tank and will feature a powerful look. It is also stated that the SUV can run 90 km without petrol. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mizoram Expands Arecanut Cultivation Across Over 67,000 Hectares
item.description: Arecanut cultivation in Mizoram has expanded to cover 67,380 hectares. The state government is exploring scientific interventions to strengthen this cultivation, according to Chief Minister Zoramthanga. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: thyssenkrupp Automotive Technology has inaugurated a new Global Capability Center in Pune. Separately, KONE has also inaugurated a digital experience center in Pune. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council has approved new reforms aimed at making the tax system 'good and simple'. Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcomed these changes, stating they would lead to faster decisions and lower compliance… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
